Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper). [12+].

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me.
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases! (My Feet Are Killing Me).

programme.title: One Day In My Body.
programme.desc: There are only two foods that won't send Caroline into anaphylaxis. Touching almost anything causes Ariana's "butterfly skin" to blister and tear. Aleazia's cystic hygroma caused his jaw and tongue to swell, permanently freezing his mouth open. (One Day in My Body).

programme.title: Suddenly Amish.
programme.desc: The Amish community faces an existential crisis: young people are leaving the church and the population is dwindling. Bishop Vernon has a radical solution: offer six outsiders the opportunity to join his community and become Amish. (Suddenly Amish).

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters.
programme.desc: With an average weight of over 1000lbs, nothing can support the Slaton sisters like they can support each other. With hopes of a healthier life, the sisters embark on a journey to drop enough weight that they qualify for a life changing bariatric surgery. Without the surgery, Amy will never be able to become a mother like she dreams of, and Tammy will be bedridden. After meeting with medical experts, the sisters strive to reach their goal but drama ensues as they struggle to stick to their healthy diets. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around? (1000-lb Sisters).

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire.
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown? (Say Yes to the Dress: England).

programme.desc: Meditation teacher Marisa and Claudio have been in love for years, but he's married and cannot commit. When she falls for new scholar Jacopo, how will Claudio react? (Alta Infedeltà).

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Benelux.
programme.desc: Wedding fashion reality series. As any bride will tell you, choosing what to wear on your big day is a daunting experience. Luckily for these Dutch and Flemish brides, they have expert designer Randy Fenoli on hand to help them with their search to find the perfect wedding dress. This show helps their brides find "the one" - their ideal dress - and makes sure they look stunning at their wedding. They must keep within budgets and deal with delicate topics such as body confidence and other personal issues. There is also the input of friends and family that the professionals must contend with. After all the stress, fittings and uncertainty - will the bride say yes to the dress and walk down the aisle in the dress of their dreams? (Say Yes to the Dress Benelux). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Curvy Brides' Boutique.
programme.desc: In order to reduce stress for plus-sized brides-to-be, best friends and fashion entrepreneurs Alison Law and Jo Cooke start Curves and Couture, a wedding boutique in Essex, London. The shop was inspired by their own miserable experience while shopping for wedding dresses. This is the case when size does not matter. The focus of the reality TV series Curvy Brides' Boutique is on finding the Dress for every single curvy bride and make her wedding day full of wonderful memories. The show follows the bride from the moment she chooses her dress, to her fitting and on her wedding day. (The Curvy Brides' Boutique).

programme.desc: Elena and Giovanni's friend -- the pilot Marco -- has always been in love with Elena. (Alta Infedeltà).

programme.title: High Infidelity.
programme.desc: Sabrina and Luca are married, but Luca is betraying his wife with his old friend Carla. Sabrina, suspicious about her husband and Carla's friendship, tries to figure out what is happening between them. (Alta Infedeltà).

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville.
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children. (Welcome To Plathville). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Little People, Big World.
programme.desc: Matt and Amy Roloff, both 4 feet tall, face a variety of challenges in raising their four children: twins Jeremy and Zach, who is 2-feet shorter than his brother, and younger siblings Molly and Jacob, who like Jeremy are average height. The family's 34-acre Oregon farm serves as part playground and part moneymaker. As the series ages, Matt and Amy deal with personal strife, embrace their kids getting older and leading lives of their own, become grandparents, and attempt to keep Roloff Farms operational. (Little People, Big World). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons.
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs." (7 Little Johnstons).

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress.
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss. (Say Yes to the Dress).

programme.title: Kitchen Boss.
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website. (Kitchen Boss). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Cake Boss.
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships. (Cake Boss). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Nate & Jeremiah by Design.
programme.desc: Interior designer Nate Berkus is joined by his husband, fellow designer Jeremiah Brent, as hosts of this home renovation show. Both designers use their undisputed skills to help out homeowners who are stuck in the middle of horrendous home improvement nightmares and who are facing financial ruin because of it. Their aim is to turn the homeowner's money pit into a major asset. Each hour-long episode features a different renovation problem and the two designers use unique design pieces and their own personal touch to add character and value to each project. The series also invites the viewer into the couples' private life to show they cope with raising their daughter, Poppy, "the girl that changed everything.". (Nate & Jeremiah by Design). programme.title: The Mad Pooper.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire.
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown? (Say Yes to the Dress: England).

On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs." (7 Little Johnstons).

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way.
programme.desc: In a spin off of the US series 90 Day Fiance, Americans move to foreign countries to pursue romances and get married. In the original show, partners move into the US on a K-1 visa and have 90 days to settle before the wedding due to the visa process. This spin off sees US citizens applying for their own visas abroad, experiencing culture shocks and leaving behind their entire families for their fiance. These engagements aren't without drama, secrets and lies come to light and relationships are tested to the extreme. Will these Americans find happiness and love abroad, or will they be booking a flight back home? (The 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress.
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss. (Say Yes to the Dress).

programme.title: Kitchen Boss.
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website. (Kitchen Boss). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Cake Boss.
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships. (Cake Boss). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: 1000-lb Roomies.
programme.desc: Jaz and Nesha's girls' trip to Mexico gets off to a rocky start; after a stressful flight, accessibility challenges, and beach mishaps, tensions rise between the roomies; a poolside argument tests their friendship. (1000-lb Roomies). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic.
programme.desc: British docuseries following the work of leading dermatologist, Dr Emma Craythorne as she explores extreme skin conditions. Join her team at their Harley Street clinic in London, as she meets patients who have been seriously affected by a range of often debilitating conditions. From severe acne and rosacea to deep painful cysts, follow the stories of the patients from diagnosis through to recovery as they undergo dramatic cosmetic procedures. For the patients who had once struggled to leave their home, will their treatment under knives, needles and lasers help change their skin and lives for good? (Save My Skin). [12+].

programme.title: Too Large.
programme.desc: Bryan's obesity has caused him to be depressed and miss too many activities with his friends. On top of that, he is desperate to spend more time with his daughter. Bryan decides bariatric surgery is the only way to transform his body and his life. (Dangerously Obese). [12+].

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me.
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases! (My Feet Are Killing Me). [12+].

programme.title: Little People, Big World.
programme.desc: It's the end of an era on LITTLE PEOPLE, BIG WORLD as Amy prepares to say goodbye to the farm for good. But while she's officially moving off the farm, she still co-owns part of it with Matt, who is eager to get everything settled between them in terms of ownership. Meanwhile, Zach and Tori are experiencing the joys and challenges of parenthood with baby Lilah and Jackson, making sure both children are getting the care and attention they need. The new episodes also offer a glimpse into how the Roloff's world is impacted by the COVID-19 crisis, from a quarantine birthday party to the stress of moving in the middle of a pandemic. programme.title: Welcome To Plathville.

Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children. (Welcome To Plathville). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters.
programme.desc: With an average weight of over 1000lbs, nothing can support the Slaton sisters like they can support each other. With hopes of a healthier life, the sisters embark on a journey to drop enough weight that they qualify for a life changing bariatric surgery. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around? (1000-lb Sisters).

programme.title: Suddenly Amish.
programme.desc: The Amish community faces an existential crisis: young people are leaving the church and the population is dwindling. Bishop Vernon has a radical solution: offer six outsiders the opportunity to join his community and become Amish. (Suddenly Amish).

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters.
programme.desc: With an average weight of over 1000lbs, nothing can support the Slaton sisters like they can support each other. With hopes of a healthier life, the sisters embark on a journey to drop enough weight that they qualify for a life changing bariatric surgery. Without the surgery, Amy will never be able to become a mother like she dreams of, and Tammy will be bedridden. After meeting with medical experts, the sisters strive to reach their goal but drama ensues as they struggle to stick to their healthy diets. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around? (1000-lb Sisters).

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me.
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases! (My Feet Are Killing Me). [12+].

Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases! (My Feet Are Killing Me). [12+].

programme.title: The Alaska Triangle.
programme.desc: Experts and eyewitnesses attempt to unlock the mystery of the Alaska Triangle, a remote area infamous for alien abductions, Bigfoot sightings, paranormal phenomena and vanishing airplanes. Throughout the series, we meet a woman whose idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare, as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force. Recent sightings may prove that a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants is true. The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950. (The Alaska Triangle). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: Cold Warrior: December 1998 - NASA astronauts begin construction of the International Space Station and photograph a strange object that some link to the 1950s story of the 'Black Knight'. Space Geysers: The Casini probe takes pictures of Saturn's moon Enceladus and sees massive geysers of liquid water on a moon that should be dead. These geysers also contain the building blocks of life. Hole in the Sun: July 18, 2013 - Scientists observing the Sun see what appears to be a 500,000 mile hole creep across the Surface of the Sun. Alien Spies: September 2002 - An amateur astronomer spots a bright object orbiting Earth. He reports the object to the authorities and NASA scientists are surprised to find the object covered in paint. Martian Tracks: November 1971 - Mariner 9 arrives on Mars and sends back images of unusual tracks on the planet's surface. Faster Than The Speed of Light: December 1995 - The Hubble Telescope is pointed at a completely empty spot of sky to see what's there and surprisingly the faint galaxies seen appear to be traveling faster than the speed of light. STS-114 Boomerang: July 26, 2005 - One of the cameras from Space Shuttle Discovery sees an object change direction own its own. We Are The Aliens: The theory of Panspermia is that life here on Earth may have originated elsewhere, by riding rocks to Earth after being knocked off other planets by asteroid strikes. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: A distant planet shows evidence of an Earth-like atmosphere, while a mysterious light suggests an atmosphere on the Moon. Have we found evidence of a crashed alien ship in the asteroid belt? Why are there "blueberries" on Mars? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 03/18/2014 Apollo 12 Follower: Shortly after Apollo 12's launch the ship is struck by lightning, twice. After the ship computers recover from the lightning strike the mission continues and strange objects are seen following the moon landing. Alien Crash Site: The Dawn space probe in 2011 studies Vesta, a 4.5 million year old asteroid in the Asteroid Belt. Pictures seem to show the crash site of a triangular shaped object. Could it be a failed attempt at mining asteroids for precious metals by a race from beyond the solar system. The Gemini X Incident: A mission meant to learn how to dock with booster rockets in space turns strange when the astronauts spot flashing objects that suddenly disappear. Alien Cloud: A planet 63 light years away is photographed by the Hubble Telescope. Studies of these photos show the presence of methane that may indicate life. Skylab's Gremlins: NASA's Skylab is plagued by accidents, almost from the start of the mission. While trying to figure out why the mission has so many problems scientists see a photo of a mysterious object that leave and then returns. Mars Blueberries: The Opportunity rover lands on Mars and the first thing it photographs is little round rocks that are less red than everything else seen on the planet. Hubble Encounter: On the mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope, the crew sees multiple objects buzz the mission as if watching their progress. Moon Glow: Surveyor 7 lands on the Moon prior to the first manned mission and photographs an unexpected glow. When an Apollo 17 astronaut reports a glow on the horizon, NASA finally attempts to understand the phenomenon. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature. (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable. (Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern).

programme.title: Mountain Monsters.
programme.desc: Mountain Monsters is an American cryptozoology-themed reality TV series revolving around the Appalachian Investigators of Mysterious Sightings team. It is a group of six skilled native West Virginian hunters and trappers. They are on a mission to study and track unidentified creatures in the Appalachian Mountains. Their main goal is to prove that mysterious creatures like Bigfoot, Werewolf, Hellhound, Lizard Man, and Mothman do exist and provide the proper evidence to the viewers. (Mountain Monsters). [12+]. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Beyond The Unknown.
programme.desc: Don Wildman explores extraordinary stories in this riveting documentary series, delving into myths, legends, and local tales to reveal the truth behind a number of perplexing tales. His adventures take him all across the American landscape as he attempts to get to the bottom of some of history's most intriguing stories, examining astonishing and implausible events. Each episode focusses on a variety of inextricable events, using interviews, archive footage, and dramatised re-enactments to portray the implausible. Let Don take you Beyond the Unknown; a world of bizarre occurrences, peculiarities, sinister evils, and unsolved happenings. (Beyond the Unknown).

programme.title: Ghost Asylum.
programme.desc: Featuring a fearless crew on a quest to hunt down chain-rattling ghosts and scary apparitions in anyway they can, Ghost Asylum follows a passionate paranormal team in America, the Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) as they attempt to "trap ghosts" in the country's most haunted abandoned asylums, mental hospitals and sanitariums. Using their Sourthern charm and engineering knowledge to create supernatural inventions during their hunting to find ghosts or spirits of any kind. Their speciality is investigating the decaying, haunting and skin crawling mental institutions throughout the USA, warning viewers that they have permission to enter the most haunted buildings and that chasing ghosts without proper training "will get you killed", so don't try this at home. (Ghost Asylum). [12+].

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: What could make a NASA astronaut report seeing a flying saucer in the skies above a US Air Force test range? How have the swirling gases of Saturn formed a perfect Hexagon that has hovered above the planet's pole for 30 years? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 07/24/2014 U.S. UFO: Capitan Gordon Cooper sends two camera men to the area to set up filming equipment a test site, but they film a UFO landing instead. The Mega Hex: The Voyager Space craft takes photos of Saturn and appears to show a giant Hexagon engulfing the poles. 24 years later the Casini spacecraft takes better pictures that confirm the hexagon is still there. Lunar Lights: Apollo 14 is plagued with technical problems, but they make it safely to the surface on the moon. After developing film taken on the moon show mysterious blue lights. Discovery Déja Vu: 2001 Space Shuttle Discovery external camera seem multiple objects moving independently. The WOW Factor: August 1977 a signal is picked up coming from deep space. Space Squid: December 1968 - Apollo 8 takes photos of the moon, but when developed the film show something with tentacles in space near the moon. Space Angels: Space Shuttle Atlantis films thunderstorms from space. The film shows giant discharges above the clouds, that look like electrified jellyfish. Interstellar Power Stations: Dr. Dick Carrigan is looking at the infrared data collected by observation satellites to find Dyson's Sphere. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: Cold Warrior: December 1998 - NASA astronauts begin construction of the International Space Station and photograph a strange object that some link to the 1950s story of the 'Black Knight'. Space Geysers: The Casini probe takes pictures of Saturn's moon Enceladus and sees massive geysers of liquid water on a moon that should be dead. These geysers also contain the building blocks of life. Hole in the Sun: July 18, 2013 - Scientists observing the Sun see what appears to be a 500,000 mile hole creep across the Surface of the Sun. Alien Spies: September 2002 - An amateur astronomer spots a bright object orbiting Earth. He reports the object to the authorities and NASA scientists are surprised to find the object covered in paint. Martian Tracks: November 1971 - Mariner 9 arrives on Mars and sends back images of unusual tracks on the planet's surface. programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: A distant planet shows evidence of an Earth-like atmosphere, while a mysterious light suggests an atmosphere on the Moon. Have we found evidence of a crashed alien ship in the asteroid belt? Why are there "blueberries" on Mars? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 03/18/2014 Apollo 12 Follower: Shortly after Apollo 12's launch the ship is struck by lightning, twice. After the ship computers recover from the lightning strike the mission continues and strange objects are seen following the moon landing. Alien Crash Site: The Dawn space probe in 2011 studies Vesta, a 4.5 million year old asteroid in the Asteroid Belt. Pictures seem to show the crash site of a triangular shaped object. Could it be a failed attempt at mining asteroids for precious metals by a race from beyond the solar system. The Gemini X Incident: A mission meant to learn how to dock with booster rockets in space turns strange when the astronauts spot flashing objects that suddenly disappear. Alien Cloud: A planet 63 light years away is photographed by the Hubble Telescope. Studies of these photos show the presence of methane that may indicate life. Skylab's Gremlins: NASA's Skylab is plagued by accidents, almost from the start of the mission. While trying to figure out why the mission has so many problems scientists see a photo of a mysterious object that leave and then returns. Mars Blueberries: The Opportunity rover lands on Mars and the first thing it photographs is little round rocks that are less red than everything else seen on the planet. Hubble Encounter: On the mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope, the crew sees multiple objects buzz the mission as if watching their progress. Moon Glow: Surveyor 7 lands on the Moon prior to the first manned mission and photographs an unexpected glow. When an Apollo 17 astronaut reports a glow on the horizon, NASA finally attempts to understand the phenomenon. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: Could spaceships be powered by atomic bombs? Can artificial rings encircle an entire star? why was Neil Armstrong's transmission feed cut off when he spotted strange lights on the Moon? And how can lightning talk to itself? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 07/20/2014 The Aristarchus Enigma: Apollo 11 astronauts see illumination coming from the Aristarchus Crater. Martian Space Station: Mars moon Phobos may be hollow, that some believe may be a space station. Curiosity's Companions: After Curiosity lands on Mars one of the first things it sees are object apparently leaving the planet. Alien Star Drive: When an X-Ray signature is seen coming from a nearby Galactic Clusters may be an alien's nuclear drive. Intelligent Lighting: Lightning appears to flash in sequence between storms that are far apart. Mir Mystery: Objects buzz the Mir Space Station during the shuttle docking procedure. Many believe something has been trying to sabotage the station. Moon Watcher: Photos taken by the Apollo 17 astronauts seem to show an object apparently watching their activities. Kuiper Belt Intruder: More than 90% of the material that should be in the Kuiper Belt is not there. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: What could make a NASA astronaut report seeing a flying saucer in the skies above a US Air Force test range? How have the swirling gases of Saturn formed a perfect Hexagon that has hovered above the planet's pole for 30 years? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 07/24/2014 U.S. UFO: Capitan Gordon Cooper sends two camera men to the area to set up filming equipment a test site, but they film a UFO landing instead. The Mega Hex: The Voyager Space craft takes photos of Saturn and appears to show a giant Hexagon engulfing the poles. 24 years later the Casini spacecraft takes better pictures that confirm the hexagon is still there. Lunar Lights: Apollo 14 is plagued with technical problems, but they make it safely to the surface on the moon. After developing film taken on the moon show mysterious blue lights. Discovery Déja Vu: 2001 Space Shuttle Discovery external camera seem multiple objects moving independently. The WOW Factor: August 1977 a signal is picked up coming from deep space. Space Squid: December 1968 - Apollo 8 takes photos of the moon, but when developed the film show something with tentacles in space near the moon. Space Angels: Space Shuttle Atlantis films thunderstorms from space. The film shows giant discharges above the clouds, that look like electrified jellyfish. Interstellar Power Stations: Dr. Dick Carrigan is looking at the infrared data collected by observation satellites to find Dyson's Sphere. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: World's Greatest Motorcycle Rides.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid.
programme.desc: For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid. (Building Off The Grid). Gamtos.

programme.title: Barnwood Builders.
programme.desc: Barnwood Builders is an American documentary TV series following a team of builders that magically turn historic barns and log cabins into modern houses. Mark Bowe is the owner West Virginia company, he buys old barns and log cabins in order to reuse the hand-hewn logs. His professional team specializes in the reclamation and restoration of pioneer era structures in the eastern United States. The pioneers of modern days give pioneer cabins and barns a new life, they save barns with history and introduce the viewers to the incredible structures and american icons of building work. (Barnwood Builders).

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation. (The Holzer Files).

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Dave, Cindy, and Shane re-open legendary ghost hunter Hans Holzer's unusual case at the Howard Lodge, a stately manor in Maryland that possesses its former residents through haunting dreams. LONG DESCRIPTION: In 1969, Jaqueline Emery called Dr. Holzer out to investigate her home in Sykesville, Maryland, also known as the Howard Lodge, a Georgian mansion from the 1700s. She reported hearing a sick child breathing, seeing mists around the house, and feeling a presence on the second floor landing. Hans conducted his first investigation solo, but after a startling experience, he planned on returning with a medium to try and get to the bottom of the haunting. Unfortunately, when he tried to return, Jaqueline Emery changed her mind, deciding that she didn't want him back at the house. She was happy with the haunting and felt no need for further investigation. Now, 50 years after Hans Holzer first encountered the spirits of Howard Lodge, his private case file is reopened, as paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza, equipment specialist Shane Pittman - along with new insights from researcher Gabe Roth and Holzer's own daughter, Alexandra - return to Sykesville to uncover the mysteries that Hans was prevented from solving. A new key to the mystery comes with the chilling discovery that multiple former residents of Howard Lodge have been haunted by non-stop dreams of the old house. (The Holzer Files).

programme.title: Mountain Monsters.
programme.desc: Mountain Monsters is an American cryptozoology-themed reality TV series revolving around the Appalachian Investigators of Mysterious Sightings team. It is a group of six skilled native West Virginian hunters and trappers. They are on a mission to study and track unidentified creatures in the Appalachian Mountains. Their main goal is to prove that mysterious creatures like Bigfoot, Werewolf, Hellhound, Lizard Man, and Mothman do exist and provide the proper evidence to the viewers. (Mountain Monsters). [12+]. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Ghost Brothers.
programme.desc: What you see is what you get with Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey, the Southeast's newest and most dynamic paranormal investigation team. These three best friends lead Destination America's new series GHOST BROTHERS, on a mission to uncover whether some unique, legendary "haunted" houses are the real deal. Raised in religious households, Dalen, Juwan and Marcus were taught that "messing" with the dead is dangerous business, but some unexplained experiences of their own piqued their intense fascination, ultimately driving them to find out firsthand just how spooky the supernatural can be. Blending natural curiosity with comedic flair, these charismatic characters offer a fresh, funny and unique take on the spirit world. (Ghost Brothers). [12+].

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: Cold Warrior: December 1998 - NASA astronauts begin construction of the International Space Station and photograph a strange object that some link to the 1950s story of the 'Black Knight'. Space Geysers: The Casini probe takes pictures of Saturn's moon Enceladus and sees massive geysers of liquid water on a moon that should be dead. These geysers also contain the building blocks of life. Hole in the Sun: July 18, 2013 - Scientists observing the Sun see what appears to be a 500,000 mile hole creep across the Surface of the Sun. Alien Spies: September 2002 - An amateur astronomer spots a bright object orbiting Earth. He reports the object to the authorities and NASA scientists are surprised to find the object covered in paint. Martian Tracks: November 1971 - Mariner 9 arrives on Mars and sends back images of unusual tracks on the planet's surface. Faster Than The Speed of Light: December 1995 - The Hubble Telescope is pointed at a completely empty spot of sky to see what's there and surprisingly the faint galaxies seen appear to be traveling faster than the speed of light. STS-114 Boomerang: July 26, 2005 - One of the cameras from Space Shuttle Discovery sees an object change direction own its own. We Are The Aliens: The theory of Panspermia is that life here on Earth may have originated elsewhere, by riding rocks to Earth after being knocked off other planets by asteroid strikes. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: World's Greatest Motorcycle Rides.
programme.desc: Route 66 was decommissioned as an official American Highway some time ago but try telling that to Henry Cole. Six years after his previous pilgrimage, Henry fires up the beast and feels the pull of a fresh adventure on 'The Mother Road'. The 90 degree heat, 100% humidity and torrential rain turn out to be the least of his problems. The real ones come in the shape of the UFO Hunters, real gun slingers, eccentric millionaires and other frightening bikers Henry meets as he traverses the 2500 mile route. Is the myth growing more magical or is it fading into folklore? You can trust Henry to tell you straight as he gets his kicks on Route 66. (World's Greatest Motorcycle Rides).

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: A distant planet shows evidence of an Earth-like atmosphere, while a mysterious light suggests an atmosphere on the Moon. Have we found evidence of a crashed alien ship in the asteroid belt? Why are there "blueberries" on Mars? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 03/18/2014 Apollo 12 Follower: Shortly after Apollo 12's launch the ship is struck by lightning, twice. After the ship computers recover from the lightning strike the mission continues and strange objects are seen following the moon landing. Alien Crash Site: The Dawn space probe in 2011 studies Vesta, a 4.5 million year old asteroid in the Asteroid Belt. Pictures seem to show the crash site of a triangular shaped object. Could it be a failed attempt at mining asteroids for precious metals by a race from beyond the solar system. The Gemini X Incident: A mission meant to learn how to dock with booster rockets in space turns strange when the astronauts spot flashing objects that suddenly disappear. Alien Cloud: A planet 63 light years away is photographed by the Hubble Telescope. Studies of these photos show the presence of methane that may indicate life. Skylab's Gremlins: NASA's Skylab is plagued by accidents, almost from the start of the mission. While trying to figure out why the mission has so many problems scientists see a photo of a mysterious object that leave and then returns. Mars Blueberries: The Opportunity rover lands on Mars and the first thing it photographs is little round rocks that are less red than everything else seen on the planet. Hubble Encounter: On the mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope, the crew sees multiple objects buzz the mission as if watching their progress. Moon Glow: Surveyor 7 lands on the Moon prior to the first manned mission and photographs an unexpected glow. When an Apollo 17 astronaut reports a glow on the horizon, NASA finally attempts to understand the phenomenon. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Dave, Cindy, and Shane re-open legendary ghost hunter Hans Holzer's unusual case at the Howard Lodge, a stately manor in Maryland that possesses its former residents through haunting dreams. LONG DESCRIPTION: In 1969, Jaqueline Emery called Dr. Holzer out to investigate her home in Sykesville, Maryland, also known as the Howard Lodge, a Georgian mansion from the 1700s. A new key to the mystery comes with the chilling discovery that multiple former residents of Howard Lodge have been haunted by non-stop dreams of the old house. (The Holzer Files).

programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable. (Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern).

programme.title: Extraterrestrials Debrief: Expedition Unknown.

In this four-part documentary series explorer Josh Gates attempts to answer that age-old question, as he examines stories, rumours and reported sightings of extraterrestrials and alien life. programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation. (The Holzer Files).

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.

(Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern).

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation. (The Holzer Files).

programme.title: Xplore Philippines.
programme.desc: In the last of the series, Simon Reeve leads a team of journalists on a journey of discovery in the Philippines, from the staggering scenery of the mountainous rice terraces in the north, to the war-torn Muslim regions of the south. In the capital, Manila, population pressure has led to some surprising consequences. The city's largest cemetery has become home to a thriving community, who look after the tombs of the rich but also have their own schools and shops. The country is still in some political turmoil and a long-running communist insurgence has led to allegations of illegal killings by the army. Simon meets a general known as 'The Butcher'. Simon also has a surreal encounter from the past - an interview with Imelda Marcos, who is marketing a new line in beauty products. It's a stunning country with bizarre wild life and a population of tropical 'Sea Gypsies' whose lifestyle is feeling pressure from the modern world. (Xplore Philippines).

programme.title: Xplore Philippines.
programme.desc: In the last of the series, Simon Reeve leads a team of journalists on a journey of discovery in the Philippines, from the staggering scenery of the mountainous rice terraces in the north, to the war-torn Muslim regions of the south. In the capital, Manila, population pressure has led to some surprising consequences. The city's largest cemetery has become home to a thriving community, who look after the tombs of the rich but also have their own schools and shops. The country is still in some political turmoil and a long-running communist insurgence has led to allegations of illegal killings by the army. Simon meets a general known as 'The Butcher'. Simon also has a surreal encounter from the past - an interview with Imelda Marcos, who is marketing a new line in beauty products. It's a stunning country with bizarre wild life and a population of tropical 'Sea Gypsies' whose lifestyle is feeling pressure from the modern world. (Xplore Philippines).

programme.title: Xplore Philippines.
programme.desc: In the last of the series, Simon Reeve leads a team of journalists on a journey of discovery in the Philippines, from the staggering scenery of the mountainous rice terraces in the north, to the war-torn Muslim regions of the south. In the capital, Manila, population pressure has led to some surprising consequences. The city's largest cemetery has become home to a thriving community, who look after the tombs of the rich but also have their own schools and shops. The country is still in some political turmoil and a long-running communist insurgence has led to allegations of illegal killings by the army. Simon meets a general known as 'The Butcher'. Simon also has a surreal encounter from the past - an interview with Imelda Marcos, who is marketing a new line in beauty products. It's a stunning country with bizarre wild life and a population of tropical 'Sea Gypsies' whose lifestyle is feeling pressure from the modern world. (Xplore Philippines).

programme.title: Xplore Philippines.
programme.desc: In the last of the series, Simon Reeve leads a team of journalists on a journey of discovery in the Philippines, from the staggering scenery of the mountainous rice terraces in the north, to the war-torn Muslim regions of the south. In the capital, Manila, population pressure has led to some surprising consequences. The city's largest cemetery has become home to a thriving community, who look after the tombs of the rich but also have their own schools and shops. The country is still in some political turmoil and a long-running communist insurgence has led to allegations of illegal killings by the army. Simon meets a general known as 'The Butcher'. Simon also has a surreal encounter from the past - an interview with Imelda Marcos, who is marketing a new line in beauty products. It's a stunning country with bizarre wild life and a population of tropical 'Sea Gypsies' whose lifestyle is feeling pressure from the modern world. (Xplore Philippines).

programme.title: Xplore Philippines.
programme.desc: In the last of the series, Simon Reeve leads a team of journalists on a journey of discovery in the Philippines, from the staggering scenery of the mountainous rice terraces in the north, to the war-torn Muslim regions of the south. In the capital, Manila, population pressure has led to some surprising consequences. The city's largest cemetery has become home to a thriving community, who look after the tombs of the rich but also have their own schools and shops. The country is still in some political turmoil and a long-running communist insurgence has led to allegations of illegal killings by the army. Simon meets a general known as 'The Butcher'. Simon also has a surreal encounter from the past - an interview with Imelda Marcos, who is marketing a new line in beauty products. It's a stunning country with bizarre wild life and a population of tropical 'Sea Gypsies' whose lifestyle is feeling pressure from the modern world. (Xplore Philippines).

programme.title: Xplore Philippines.
programme.desc: In the last of the series, Simon Reeve leads a team of journalists on a journey of discovery in the Philippines, from the staggering scenery of the mountainous rice terraces in the north, to the war-torn Muslim regions of the south. In the capital, Manila, population pressure has led to some surprising consequences. The city's largest cemetery has become home to a thriving community, who look after the tombs of the rich but also have their own schools and shops. The country is still in some political turmoil and a long-running communist insurgence has led to allegations of illegal killings by the army. Simon meets a general known as 'The Butcher'. Simon also has a surreal encounter from the past - an interview with Imelda Marcos, who is marketing a new line in beauty products. It's a stunning country with bizarre wild life and a population of tropical 'Sea Gypsies' whose lifestyle is feeling pressure from the modern world. (Xplore Philippines).

programme.title: Meilės spąstai.
programme.desc: Romantikos ir švelnaus humoro prisotintas turkų draminis serialas pasakoja Aišės - geraširdės, bet ambicingos jaunos tekstilės darbuotojos - ir Keremo - nerūpestingo, žavaus mados imperijos paveldėtojo - istoriją. Dėl virtinės nesusipratimų jiedu įsipainioja į vienas kito gyvenimus priversti sudaryti fiktyvią santuoką, kad apsaugotų savo reputaciją. Kokių netikėtų vingių jiems dar atseikės likimas? (Afili Aşk). [7+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ūkininkas ieško žmonos.
programme.desc: Visame pasaulyje populiarus pasimatymų šou. Penki vieniši australai, kaimo vaikinai, ieško savo gyvenimo meilės. Su ūkininkais trokš susipažinti būrys vienišų miestiečių merginų, jos eis į pasimatymus, o labiausiai patikusias vaikinai pakvies apsigyventi savo ūkyje, kad geriau su jomis susipažintų. Tada ūkininkas išsirinks tą vienintelę, su kuria norės tęsti pažintį. (The Farmer Wants a Wife Australia).

programme.title: Pertrauka.

programme.title: Kakava.
programme.desc: "Kakava" – tai pasakojimas, kurio veiksmas vyksta dviejose šalyse: Portugalijoje ir Brazilijoje. Siužetas pasakoja apie jaunos merginos, gyvenančios ūkyje Itakarėje, Bahijoje, su savo portugalų tėvais Joaquimu ir Filomena, turtingo savininko Justino patikimais žmonėmis, gyvenimą. Cacau svajoja gauti šokolado gamybos diplomą, tačiau jai trūksta pinigų tai padaryti. Viskas pasikeičia, kai jos tėvas sulaužo seną susitarimą ir atskleidžia savo tikrąją tapatybę, o Justino sužino, kad turėjo dukrą su kita moterimi. Šis atskleidimas išprovokuoja intrigų ir konfliktų seriją, kuri kelia grėsmę šeimos palikimui, nes Cacau tampa grėsme kitiems paveldėtojams. (Cacau). [7+].

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Šio mistinio serialo istorijos paimtos iš realaus aiškiarėgės Ninos, kuri yra lyginama su garsiąja Vanga, gyvenimo. Kiekviena serija pasakoja vis naują istoriją, kurioje Nina kas kartą į ją besikreipiantiems žmonėms įkvėps vilties ir palaikymo. Ir nors nuošaliame kaimelyje gyvenanti senolė vengia žmonių dėmesio, ji niekam neatsako padėti. (Слепая). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Leila.
programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Einšteinas.
programme.desc: Feliksas - jauniausias teorinės fizikos profesorius universitete ir mokslininko Einšteino pro proanūkis. Iš pirmo žvilgsnio jis linksmas ir nerūpestingas vyrukas. Tačiau Felikas sunkiai serga ir gali būti, kad senatvės nebesulauks. Pašėlęs Felikso būdas įklampiną jaunąjį profesorių į problemas su teisėsauga. Kodėl Feliksas bus priverstas dirbti policijos pagalbininku ir kaip jam seksis, sužinosite komiškame seriale. (Einstein). [7+]. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Medicina. Dramos.

programme.title: Įstatymas ir tvarka. Specialiųjų tyrimų skyrius.
programme.desc: Šis amerikiečių policijos procedūrinis serialas pasakoja apie Niujorke veikiančią Specialiųjų aukų skyrių (SVU). SVU – tai atrinkta Niujorko policijos departamento (NYPD) detektyvų komanda, kuriai tenka tirti įvairius šokiruojančius ir neapsakomus seksualinius nusikaltimus. Ši ilgai rodoma serialo serija, populiarios kriminalinės dramos "Law & Order" atšaka, vaizduoja sudėtingas bylas, įskaitant išžaginimus, pedofiliją, pagrobimus, vaikų išnaudojimą ir smurtą šeimoje. Kartais, semdamiesi įkvėpimo iš realaus gyvenimo, epizodai laisvai remiasi tikrais nusikaltimais. (Law & Order: Special Victims Unit). [7+]. Kriminalai. Dramos. Trileriai. Mistika.

programme.title: Užjūrio detektyvai.
programme.desc: Veiksmas vyksta Karibų rojaus saloje Martinikoje. Istorijos centre dviejų moterų tyrėjų istorija. Melisa, vieniša motina, kuri, nors ir gimusi Martinikoje, prieš kurį laiką išvyko į Prancūziją ir tik neseniai grįžo, ir Gaelle, užsispyrusi trisdešimtmetė, kuri salą pažįsta kaip savo penkis pirštus. Tarp įtampos ir juoko, šis prancūziškas kriminalinis serialas mus įtraukia į įdomią ir linksmą žmogžudystės mįslę. (Pacific Criminal). [7+]. Kriminalai. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Anupama.
programme.desc: Ji daug paaukojo, kad taptų ištikima žmona, atsidavusia marčia ir mylinčia motina, o mainais pelnė didžiulę nepagarbą. Nepaisydama karčios tiesos, ji stengsis gyventi toliau. (Anupamaa). Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.
programme.desc: Dvi seserys ir du skirtingi jų likimai. Vyresnioji, paaukojusi savo gyvenimą šeimai ir vyrui, siekia apsaugoti jaunėlę nuo klaidų. Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Šio mistinio serialo istorijos paimtos iš realaus aiškiarėgės Ninos, kuri yra lyginama su garsiąja Vanga, gyvenimo. Kiekviena serija pasakoja vis naują istoriją, kurioje Nina kas kartą į ją besikreipiantiems žmonėms įkvėps vilties ir palaikymo. Ir nors nuošaliame kaimelyje gyvenanti senolė vengia žmonių dėmesio, ji niekam neatsako padėti. (Слепая). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Pirmieji pasimatymai.
programme.desc: Akli pirmieji pasimatymai visuomet kelia stresą - ar jaudulys nepakiš kojos, ar bus apie ką kalbėtis, ar partneris nenuvils? Realybės šou, kuriame nejaukias akimirkas keičia juokingi nutikimai, abejingumą - aistringi susižavėjimai. Nuotaikingas, netikėtų situacijų, nusikalbėjimų, susikalbėjimų ir šokiruojančių prisipažinimų kupinas šou. Ar pirmas pasimatymas netaps paskutiniu? (First Dates). [7+].

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Ligoninės gydytojų grupė kasdien susiduria su asmeniniais ir profesiniais iššūkiais. Vienas jų - ir idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas. Dar per jaunas kad juo patikėtų, bet jau per gudrus, kad paklustų taisyklėms. (NCIS: New Orleans). [7+]. Mistika. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Gėlės virš pragaro.
programme.desc: Kriminalinis serialas, kurio veiksmas vyksta atokiame Italijos Alpių kaimelyje. Istorija sukasi apie inspektorę Teresą Battaglia, detektyvę su solidžia patirtimi, kuri tiria seriją žiaurių žmogžudysčių. Teresa, kovodama su savo sveikatos problemomis, turi susidurti ir su tamsiąja praeitimi bei žudiku, kuris taikosi į vietinius vaikus. (Fiori sopra l'inferno: I casi di Teresa Battaglia). [14+]. Trileriai.

programme.title: Keliautojas.
programme.desc: Kasmet Prancūzijoje neišaiškinama daugiau nei 300 žmogžudysčių. Sugniuždytos aukų šeimos patiria begalinį sielvartą. Valstybės teismų sistema dažnai pasirodo esanti bejėgė, todėl žudikų medžioklė tampa Keliautoju praminto detektyvo, jau išėjusio į pensiją, pareiga. Jo tikslas - padėti netektį patyrusioms šeimoms pasiekti teisingumą. (Le voyageur). [14+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Leila.
programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Meilės spąstai.
programme.desc: Romantikos ir švelnaus humoro prisotintas turkų draminis serialas pasakoja Aišės - geraširdės, bet ambicingos jaunos tekstilės darbuotojos - ir Keremo - nerūpestingo, žavaus mados imperijos paveldėtojo - istoriją. Dėl virtinės nesusipratimų jiedu įsipainioja į vienas kito gyvenimus priversti sudaryti fiktyvią santuoką, kad apsaugotų savo reputaciją. Kokių netikėtų vingių jiems dar atseikės likimas? (Afili Aşk). [7+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ūkininkas ieško žmonos.
programme.desc: Visame pasaulyje populiarus pasimatymų šou. Penki vieniši australai, kaimo vaikinai, ieško savo gyvenimo meilės. Su ūkininkais trokš susipažinti būrys vienišų miestiečių merginų, jos eis į pasimatymus, o labiausiai patikusias vaikinai pakvies apsigyventi savo ūkyje, kad geriau su jomis susipažintų. Tada ūkininkas išsirinks tą vienintelę, su kuria norės tęsti pažintį. (The Farmer Wants a Wife Australia).

programme.title: Pertrauka.
programme.desc: Lietuviški TV kanalai tiesiogiai internetu bet kokiame įrenginyje. Išbandyk Go3

programme.title: Kakava.
programme.desc: "Kakava" – tai pasakojimas, kurio veiksmas vyksta dviejose šalyse: Portugalijoje ir Brazilijoje. Siužetas pasakoja apie jaunos merginos, gyvenančios ūkyje Itakarėje, Bahijoje, su savo portugalų tėvais Joaquimu ir Filomena, turtingo savininko Justino patikimais žmonėmis, gyvenimą. Cacau svajoja gauti šokolado gamybos diplomą, tačiau jai trūksta pinigų tai padaryti. Viskas pasikeičia, kai jos tėvas sulaužo seną susitarimą ir atskleidžia savo tikrąją tapatybę, o Justino sužino, kad turėjo dukrą su kita moterimi. Šis atskleidimas išprovokuoja intrigų ir konfliktų seriją, kuri kelia grėsmę šeimos palikimui, nes Cacau tampa grėsme kitiems paveldėtojams. (Cacau). [7+].

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Einšteinas.
programme.desc: Feliksas - jauniausias teorinės fizikos profesorius universitete ir mokslininko Einšteino pro proanūkis. Iš pirmo žvilgsnio jis linksmas ir nerūpestingas vyrukas. Tačiau Felikas sunkiai serga ir gali būti, kad senatvės nebesulauks. Pašėlęs Felikso būdas įklampiną jaunąjį profesorių į problemas su teisėsauga. Kodėl Feliksas bus priverstas dirbti policijos pagalbininku ir kaip jam seksis, sužinosite komiškame seriale. (Einstein). [7+]. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Dramos. Medicina.

programme.title: Leila.
programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Meilės spąstai.
programme.desc: Romantikos ir švelnaus humoro prisotintas turkų draminis serialas pasakoja Aišės - geraširdės, bet ambicingos jaunos tekstilės darbuotojos - ir Keremo - nerūpestingo, žavaus mados imperijos paveldėtojo - istoriją. Dėl virtinės nesusipratimų jiedu įsipainioja į vienas kito gyvenimus priversti sudaryti fiktyvią santuoką, kad apsaugotų savo reputaciją. Kokių netikėtų vingių jiems dar atseikės likimas? (Afili Aşk). [7+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ūkininkas ieško žmonos.
programme.desc: Visame pasaulyje populiarus pasimatymų šou. Penki vieniši australai, kaimo vaikinai, ieško savo gyvenimo meilės. Su ūkininkais trokš susipažinti būrys vienišų miestiečių merginų, jos eis į pasimatymus, o labiausiai patikusias vaikinai pakvies apsigyventi savo ūkyje, kad geriau su jomis susipažintų. Tada ūkininkas išsirinks tą vienintelę, su kuria norės tęsti pažintį. (The Farmer Wants a Wife Australia).

programme.title: Pertrauka.
programme.desc: Lietuviški TV kanalai tiesiogiai internetu bet kokiame įrenginyje. Išbandyk Go3

programme.title: Kakava.
programme.desc: "Kakava" – tai pasakojimas, kurio veiksmas vyksta dviejose šalyse: Portugalijoje ir Brazilijoje. Siužetas pasakoja apie jaunos merginos, gyvenančios ūkyje Itakarėje, Bahijoje, su savo portugalų tėvais Joaquimu ir Filomena, turtingo savininko Justino patikimais žmonėmis, gyvenimą. Cacau svajoja gauti šokolado gamybos diplomą, tačiau jai trūksta pinigų tai padaryti. Viskas pasikeičia, kai jos tėvas sulaužo seną susitarimą ir atskleidžia savo tikrąją tapatybę, o Justino sužino, kad turėjo dukrą su kita moterimi. Šis atskleidimas išprovokuoja intrigų ir konfliktų seriją, kuri kelia grėsmę šeimos palikimui, nes Cacau tampa grėsme kitiems paveldėtojams. (Cacau). [7+].

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Šio mistinio serialo istorijos paimtos iš realaus aiškiarėgės Ninos, kuri yra lyginama su garsiąja Vanga, gyvenimo. Kiekviena serija pasakoja vis naują istoriją, kurioje Nina kas kartą į ją besikreipiantiems žmonėms įkvėps vilties ir palaikymo. Ir nors nuošaliame kaimelyje gyvenanti senolė vengia žmonių dėmesio, ji niekam neatsako padėti. (Слепая). [7+]. Mistika. Dramos.

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Einšteinas.
programme.desc: Feliksas - jauniausias teorinės fizikos profesorius universitete ir mokslininko Einšteino pro proanūkis. Iš pirmo žvilgsnio jis linksmas ir nerūpestingas vyrukas. Tačiau Felikas sunkiai serga ir gali būti, kad senatvės nebesulauks. Pašėlęs Felikso būdas įklampiną jaunąjį profesorių į problemas su teisėsauga. Kodėl Feliksas bus priverstas dirbti policijos pagalbininku ir kaip jam seksis, sužinosite komiškame seriale. (Einstein). [7+]. Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Dramos. Medicina.

programme.title: Anupama.
programme.desc: Ji daug paaukojo, kad taptų ištikima žmona, atsidavusia marčia ir mylinčia motina, o mainais pelnė didžiulę nepagarbą. Nepaisydama karčios tiesos, ji stengsis gyventi toliau. (Anupamaa). Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.
programme.desc: Dvi seserys ir du skirtingi jų likimai. Vyresnioji, paaukojusi savo gyvenimą šeimai ir vyrui, siekia apsaugoti jaunėlę nuo klaidų. Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Pirmieji pasimatymai.
programme.desc: Akli pirmieji pasimatymai visuomet kelia stresą - ar jaudulys nepakiš kojos, ar bus apie ką kalbėtis, ar partneris nenuvils? Realybės šou, kuriame nejaukias akimirkas keičia juokingi nutikimai, abejingumą - aistringi susižavėjimai. Nuotaikingas, netikėtų situacijų, nusikalbėjimų, susikalbėjimų ir šokiruojančių prisipažinimų kupinas šou. Ar pirmas pasimatymas netaps paskutiniu? (First Dates). [7+].

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Einšteinas.
programme.desc: Feliksas - jauniausias teorinės fizikos profesorius universitete ir mokslininko Einšteino pro proanūkis. Iš pirmo žvilgsnio jis linksmas ir nerūpestingas vyrukas. Tačiau Felikas sunkiai serga ir gali būti, kad senatvės nebesulauks. Pašėlęs Felikso būdas įklampiną jaunąjį profesorių į problemas su teisėsauga. Kodėl Feliksas bus priverstas dirbti policijos pagalbininku ir kaip jam seksis, sužinosite komiškame seriale. (Einstein). [7+]. Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Dramos. Medicina.

programme.title: Įstatymas ir tvarka. Specialiųjų tyrimų skyrius.
programme.desc: Šis amerikiečių policijos procedūrinis serialas pasakoja apie Niujorke veikiančią Specialiųjų aukų skyrių (SVU). SVU – tai atrinkta Niujorko policijos departamento (NYPD) detektyvų komanda, kuriai tenka tirti įvairius šokiruojančius ir neapsakomus seksualinius nusikaltimus. Ši ilgai rodoma serialo serija, populiarios kriminalinės dramos "Law & Order" atšaka, vaizduoja sudėtingas bylas, įskaitant išžaginimus, pedofiliją, pagrobimus, vaikų išnaudojimą ir smurtą šeimoje. Kartais, semdamiesi įkvėpimo iš realaus gyvenimo, epizodai laisvai remiasi tikrais nusikaltimais. (Law & Order: Special Victims Unit). [7+]. Kriminalai. Dramos. Trileriai. Mistika.

programme.title: Užjūrio detektyvai.
programme.desc: Veiksmas vyksta Karibų rojaus saloje Martinikoje. Istorijos centre dviejų moterų tyrėjų istorija. Melisa, vieniša motina, kuri, nors ir gimusi Martinikoje, prieš kurį laiką išvyko į Prancūziją ir tik neseniai grįžo, ir Gaelle, užsispyrusi trisdešimtmetė, kuri salą pažįsta kaip savo penkis pirštus. Tarp įtampos ir juoko, šis prancūziškas kriminalinis serialas mus įtraukia į įdomią ir linksmą žmogžudystės mįslę. (Pacific Criminal). [7+]. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Anupama.
programme.desc: Ji daug paaukojo, kad taptų ištikima žmona, atsidavusia marčia ir mylinčia motina, o mainais pelnė didžiulę nepagarbą. Nepaisydama karčios tiesos, ji stengsis gyventi toliau. (Anupamaa). Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.
programme.desc: Dvi seserys ir du skirtingi jų likimai. Vyresnioji, paaukojusi savo gyvenimą šeimai ir vyrui, siekia apsaugoti jaunėlę nuo klaidų. Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. Dramos.
