programme.desc: 4 "Emmy" apdovanojimams nominuotas komikas Chrisas Rockas ir jo režisūrinis debiutas žiūrovus įvels į politines intrigas. JAV nutinka nelaimė - miršta vienas kandidatas į prezidentus. Tačiau jo atstovaujamos partijos nariai visai nesutrinka ir tuoj suranda naują kandidatą į valstybės vadovo postą. Paprastas vyrukas drąsiai imasi naujo darbo ir aktyviai dalyvauja rinkiminėje kampanijoje. Jis ne tik žada laimėti rinkimus, bet sugeba susigrąžinti kadaise jį pametusią draugę... Ar tikrai šis komiškas nuotykis baigsis be pasekmių? (Head of State). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Pasimatymas su žvaigžde.
programme.desc: Mažo miestelio mergina konkurse laimi pasimatymą su įžymybe. Pasimatymui klostantis geriau nei tikėtasi, tarp merginos, įžymybės ir geriausio merginos draugo įsižiebia meilės trikampis. (Win a Date with Tad Hamilton!). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Auklė Makfi.
programme.desc: "Auklė Makfi" - tai magijos, paslapčių ir humoro kupina istorija, sukurta pagal populiarias Didžiosios Britanijos rašytojos Christiannos Brand knygas. Mirus žmonai, ponas Sedrikas Braunas (akt. Colinas Firthas) lieka vienas su septyniomis atžalomis. Mažieji Braunukai tokie padykę ir išradingi, kad visos potencialios auklės sprunka nuo jų nė neapšilusios pėdų. Bet vieną gražią dieną tarpduryje pasirodo ji - auklė Makfi (akt. Emma Thompson). Ši moteris apvers mažųjų padaužų ir jų nusivylusio tėtušio gyvenimą aukštyn kojomis. Originalus pavadinimas "Nanny McPhee". (Nanny McPhee). Komedijos. Fantastiniai.

programme.title: Tūkstantis žodžių.
programme.desc: Knygų leidybos agentas Džekas Makalas, kurį vaidina garsusis komikas, Oskarui nominuotas Eddie Murphy, yra tikras malimo liežiuviu virtuozas. Jis gali pasakyti bet ką, kad gautų ko nori. Šis plepys niekad nesusimąsto apie žodžių galią ir visai nesijaudina meluodamas. Susitikimas su motyvacinių knygų autoriumi ir savipagalbos guru Džekui bus lemtingas. Vieną naktį jo sode išaugs stebuklingas medis. Pasirodo, su kiekvienu Džeko ištartu žodžiu nukrenta po lapą. Kai lapai visi nukris, - ateis Džekui galas. Šokiruotas šios likimo išdaigos, jis nusprendžia išvis nekalbėti. Kiek ilgai saugant savo gyvybę šiam plepiui pavyks ištylėti - pamatysime juokingoje komedijoje "Tūkstantis žodžių". (A Thousand Words). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Kas čia dabar kalba?.
programme.desc: Paskutinė klasikinės komedijos trilogijos dalis, kurioje kalba naminiai gyvūnai. Johnas Travolta ir Kirstie Alley vaidina tėvus, kurie į savo šeimą priėmė du šunis. (Look Who's Talking Now). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Pramuštgalviai Paryžiuje.
programme.desc: Populiarūs animacinio filmuko herojai kraustosi į Prancūzijos sostinę! Ten jie lydi išsiblaškėlį tėvą Stju, kuris kviečiamas pataisyti didžiulio dinozauro. Dinozauras priklauso pramogų parkui ir sugedęs negali džiuginti vaikų. Čakis tikisi, kad Paryžiuje ras naują mamą, ir beveik atspėja. Atvykę keliautojai susitinka su parko direktore Koko. Ši netrukus pasirodo esanti baisiai valdinga, tačiau tėtušiai Stju tai nerūpi - jis įsimylėjęs iki ausų. Kaip jį atgrasyti nuo vedybų su blogąja valdytoja? (Rugrats in Paris: The Movie). Nuotykių. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Kriminaline Raudonkepuraites istorija.
programme.desc: Raudonkepuraitė, Vilkas, Miškininkas ir Močiutė papasakoja policijai įvykius, kurie lėmė jų susitikimą. (Hoodwinked!). Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Kėglių karalius.
programme.desc: Зоряний гравець у боулінг, чия кар'єра була передчасно перервана, сподівається привести нового вундеркінда до успіху й багатства. (Kingpin). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Pasitikėk draugais.
programme.desc: Netekusi darbo, Olivija pagalbos kreipiasi į senus bičiulius. Nėra taip paprasta - kažkasi neseniai vedė, lipa karjeros laiptais ar augina vaiką...Vėjavaikės Olivijos įsiveržimas į jų gyvenimą sukelia tam tikros sumaišties. Čia ir paaiškėja, kam iš tiesų labiau reikia pagalbos. (Friends with Money). Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Mano geriausio draugo mergina.
programme.desc: Protinga, graži ir savarankiška Aleksė - Dastino svajonių mergina. Tačiau vos po penkių savaičių draugystės Aleksė palieka vargšą vaikiną. Sugniuždytas Dastinas kreipiasi pagalbos į seną bičiulį Tenką. Pastarasis pragyvenimui užsidirba keistu būdu: jį samdo paliktieji vaikinai, prašantys suvedžioti jų merginas ir nusivesti jas į košmariškiausią pasimatymą, kad šios nieko negalvojusios grįžtų pas buvusiuosius. Tačiau planas žlunga, nes Aleksė iškart suuodžia klastą, o Tenkas ją įsimyli. (My Best Friend's Girl). [18+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Bridžitos Džouns kūdikis.
programme.desc: Bridžitai Džouns (Renée Zellweger) sukanka keturiasdešimt treji ir jos mama Pamela (Gemmaa Jones) primena, kad jei ji dar norėtų susilaukti vaikų, imtis veiksmų dabar. Per Lėktuvo katastrofą žuvusio draugo laidotuvėse ji vėl sutinka savo buvusį draugą Marką Darsį (Colin Firth), kuris atvyko su žmona Camila (Agni Scott). Po laidotuvių Bridžita sugrįžta dirbti pas draugę laidų vedėją Mirandą (Sarah Solemani), kur ji dirba laidų prodiusere. Ji pakviečia Bridžitą švęsti neseniai praėjusio jos gimtadienio, bet Bridžita atsisako ir nusprendžia švęsti su draugais. Deja, visi jos draugai užsiėmę su savo vaikais ir Bridžita lieka viena. Sudaužyta širdimi ji priima Mirandos pasiūlymą ir drauge jos išvyksta į muzikos festivalį. Tik atvykusi, Bridžita griūna veidu tiesiai į purvą ir sulaukia patrauklaus džentelmeno pagalbos. Pačiame festivalio įkarštyje, apgirtusi Bridžita įgriūna į svetimą jurtą ir nustemba pamačiusi anksčiau jai padėjusį vyrą. Jie pasimyli ir ryte ji pasprunka. Vėliau Bridžita su Marku tampa krikšto tėvais, o Markas per krikštynas jai prisipažįsta, kad skiriasi su Camila. Tuomet Markas ir Bridžita pasimyli. Po to ji prisimena, kad Markas visada teiks pirmenybę karjerai, o ne santykiams ir prieš jam atsibundant, pabėga. Bridžitai priaugus svorio, draugė Shazzer (Sally Phillips) pataria jai pasidaryti nėštumo testą, kuris patvirtina, kad Bridžita laukiasi. Dirbančią televizijos laidoje, Bridžitą pribloškia naujiena, kad nepažįstamasis iš festivalio iš tikrųjų buvo Džekas Kvantas (Patrick Dempsey) – milijardierius, sukūręs mobiliąją programėlę viengungiams. Išjungus kameras, ji prisipažįsta jam, kad laukiasi. Nors ir labai nustebęs, Džekas pasiūlo Bridžitai savo pagalbą. Vėliau ji praneša naujieną Markui, kuris labai apsidžiaugia, kad taps tėvu. Bridžita pasikviečia Džeką į darbo šventę ir nustemba ten išvydusi ir Marką. Abu vyrai puikiai sutaria ir nueina pavakarieniauti kartu su Bridžita, kuri vakarienės metu atskleidžia jiems tiesą – kad kūdikio tėvas gali būti vienas iš jų. Džekas ramiai išklauso naujieną, o Markas išeina. Per kelis nėštumo mėnesius Markas po truputėlį susitaiko su Bridžita. Padariusi klaidą darbe, ji yra priversta išeiti, kol jos neatleido. Tapusi bedarbe, ji patenka į smarkią liūtį. Pasirodo Markas ir prisipažįsta, kad jau išsiskyrė su žmona. Jie pasilenkia vienas kito pabučiuoti, bet nubėga vaisiaus vandenys. Markas ir Bridžita nuskuba į ligoninę, tačiau kelionei sutrukdo transporto kamščiai ir kelio darbai. Markas iš visų jėgų bando ją nešti, tačiau pargriūna. Sekundžių bėgyje atvyksta Džekas ir jie kartu pasiekia gimdymo namus, kuriuose Bridžita pagimdo berniuką. Markas ir Džekas susitaiko, kai Dr. Rawlings (Emma Thompson) pasiūlo jiems pasidaryti DNR tyrimą. Po metų Bridžita susituokia su savo kūdikio Viljamo tėvu, Marku Darsiu. Išsipildžius jos gyvenimo svajonėms, pora iškeliauja švęsti. (Bridget Jones's Baby). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Answer Man.
programme.desc: Everyone wants to meet Arlen Faber (Jeff Daniels), the world-famous author of the best-selling spiritual book ''Me and God'', but crotchety, disgruntled Arlen simply wants to be left alone, and so far he's been successful at keeping his identity a secret. But all that changes when troubled bookstore owner Kris Lucas (Lou Taylor Pucci) discovers his home address and barters books for Arlen's words of wisdom, and a back injury leads the reclusive writer to date chiropractor and overprotective single mother Elizabeth (Lauren Graham). As Arlen's relationships with his newfound friends grow, he must come to terms with his past and the realization that he doesn't hold all the answers. (Arlen Faber). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle.
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Nostalgia.
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles (Nostalgia). Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park.
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability. (Mi amiga del parque). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Graduate.
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel. (The Graduate). [16+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring.
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master. (Girl with a Pearl Earring). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee.
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together. (Neem me mee). [16+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Painted Veil.
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth. (The Painted Veil). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Only You.
programme.desc: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman meets the love of her life. They decide to spend the whole night together. (Only You). Romantiniai.

programme.title: Diane.
programme.desc: Diane fills her days helping others and desperately attempting to bond with her drug-addicted son. As these pieces of her existence begin to fade, she finds herself confronting memories she'd sooner forget than face. (Diane). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Practice.
programme.desc: Gustavo, an Argentine yoga instructor living in Chile who recently lost his wife and home while an injury prevents him from continuing with his yoga practice. (La práctica). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Veiksmo. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Jayne Mansfield's Car.
programme.desc: The film is set in 1969 Morrison, Alabama. The Caldwell family includes three World War II veterans—brothers played by Thornton, Bacon and Patrick—their sister Donna (LaNasa), and a patriarch, Jim Caldwell (Duvall), who is a World War I veteran. The Caldwells are involved in a cultural clash with the Bedfords, a family which includes Phillip (Stevenson), a World War II veteran, his sister Camilla (O'Connor), and their father Kingsley (Hurt), also a World War I veteran. (Jayne Mansfield's Car). Dramos.

programme.title: Something in the Air.
programme.desc: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas, Something in the Air is a poignant, semi-autobiographical film set in France a few years after the huge political and civil unrest of 1968, a borderline revolution that almost brought the country to a standstill. In 1971, a group of teenagers are still feeling the momentum of the movement, alongside disappointment that the dust is settling with little apparent change. Gilles (Clément Métayer) is finishing up at school and getting ready for art college, but his mind is filled with hard (and often conflicting) political ideologies, and as debates turn into demonstrations, and demonstrations turn into violent attacks against state, he meets more people who are angry with the political status quo, including Christine (Lola Créton), who's part of a film-making movement that celebrates the working class. Something in the Air is a moving and sometimes funny film about social inequality, and pays sound attention to a fascinating point of recent European history that is often overlooked. (Something in the Air). Dramos.

programme.title: Enduring Love.
programme.desc: Roger Michell's drama, based on Ian McEwan's novel, of unrequited love stars Daniel Craig as Joe, out with his girlfriend Claire (Samantha Morton) for a picnic in the countryside. Suddenly, over the trees, appears a hot-air balloon that lands, tipping out the pilot, and then rises again, leaving a young boy stranded in the basket. Joe and other bystanders grab the trailing ropes but, one by one, they are forced to let go as the balloon ascends, except for one person who is borne aloft, before falling to his fate. Joe and Jed (Rhys Ifans) find his body. For Claire and Joe, life returns to a semblance of normality, until Joe starts running into Jed - again and again. And as Jed's obsession grows, so does the danger to Joe and Claire. (Enduring Love). Trileriai. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Cheri.
programme.desc: During France's belle époque before World War I, elegant cars, mansions, and servants defined the lives of les grandes horizontals, the courtesans of kings and millionaires. One of the most successful, Lea de Lonval, is approaching a certain age when an older associate, Charlotte Peloux, asks Lea to take on her 19 year old son, whom Lea has called Chéri since he was a child. They become lovers and, to their surprise, the relationship lasts six years. When it ends abruptly with a marriage his mother arranges to the daughter of another courtesan, Lea finds herself miserable. (Chéri). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Sol.
programme.desc: Sol, a famous Argentine Tango performer, has lived in Buenos Aires for many years. Behind her excessive temper and her glowing smile, the Diva hides an injury from which she never really recovered: the loss of her only son, Raphaël. (Sol). [16+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: All Our Desires.
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor. (Toutes nos envies). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Unknown Country.
programme.desc: Vids reviewed: * The Matrix * Manumission the movie * Another day in paradise * The guide to G spots and multiple orgasms * The six million dollar man * The bionic woman * Human traffic * Jeremy Clarksons Head to head Nige tells us that the car is the modern Black Death. And the guys pay tribute to police squad by doing the freeze frame sketch over the end credits. (The Unknown Country). [12+]. Dramos. Nuotykių. Mistika.

programme.title: Ramen Shop.
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients. (Ramen Teh). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Love Me No More.
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend. (Deux jours à tuer). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Duchess.
programme.desc: 18th century England. Married at 17 to the rich and powerful Duke of Devonshire, Georgiana quickly charms high society with her stunning beauty, wit and love of life. However, behind this flamboyant image hides a woman who longs to be loved, a woman deserted by her husband - the only man in the kingdom indifferent to her charms - who prefers her best friend Elizabeth Foster, and who obliges her to accept a ménage à trois. Unhappy and unsatisfied, Georgiana leads a hectic social life. Her elegance, her extravagance and her taste for gambling create a sensation, particularly when she throws herself into politics alongside the Liberal Party. She's celebrated by princes and ministers. And she supports the young Member of Parliament, Charles Grey, with whom she falls passionately in love. (The Duchess). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Cathedral.
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become. (The Cathedral). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Certified Copy.
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany. (Copie conforme). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: 2 Days In Paris.
programme.desc: Marion is a French-born photographer living in New York City with her Neurosis, hypochondriacal, chain-smoking, heavily tattooed American interior designer boyfriend Jack. After a markedly unromantic trip to Venice, which was planned to re-ignite the passion in their relationship, they take a night train to Paris to pick up Marion's cat from her parents and decide to stay for two days. Jack is startled to learn Marion has remained in contact with numerous ex-lovers and becomes increasingly uncomfortable due to the language barrier and a multitude of her old flames she keeps meeting. Meanwhile, Marion wrestles with her own insecurities about love, relationships, and her impulsive nature. (Deux jours à Paris). Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Saint Frances.
programme.desc: Critically acclaimed, offbeat comedy-drama written by and starring Kelly O'Sullivan. Thirty-something waiter Bridget (O'Sullivan) finds herself adrift in life. She's yet to begin the career she wants, because she doesn't know what she wants to be. And she's yet to settle down and start a family, because she doesn't know if she wants to get married and be a mum. Indecision rules in Bridget's life. When she takes a summer gig as a nanny for an at times rather demanding six-year-old, Frances (Ramona Edith Williams), Bridget starts learning some important life lessons from the child as well as her two mums, Maya (Charin Alvarez) and Annie (Lily Mojekwu). Sometimes, even the most together of people don't really know what they're doing. And maybe that's OK. Directed by Alex Thompson. Network Premiere. (Saint Frances). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Comment c'est loin.
programme.desc: After ten years of doing nothing, Orel and Gringe are in their mid 30s and they struggle to finish their first rap album. Their texts are mostly sex jokes and booze stories and reflect the everyday life they have in a small town from France. The problem is that they never really finished a song and when their producers want to meet, they have to face a new challenge : finish their first song in the next 24h. Their old issues, the fear of failure, their alcoholic friends and annoying girlfriends won't help them to do so, or will they ? (Comment c'est loin). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Ratcatcher.
programme.desc: The film opens focused upon James' friend Ryan Quinn, who is being forced to put on his wellington boots to go to visit his father, who is in jail. But Ryan chose to play with James instead, and runs off while his mother is not looking. Ryan meets James at the canal and during some rough-house play he is drowned, clearly with James bearing much of the blame for not having raised the alarm. James believes his inaction has gone unnoticed. (Ratcatcher). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: An Argentinian Crime.
programme.desc: Rosario in the 80s. The disappearance of a man during the military dictatorship. Two young people from the court must do everything possible to solve the case while facing police corruption and various dangers that put their lives at risk. (Un crimen argentino). [16+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Dramos. Muzikiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Like a Prince.
programme.desc: Souleyman, a French boxing champion in preparation for the Olympic Games, sees his future crumble when he cracks the bones of his hand following a bar fight. He is sent to the Château de Chambord, where he must perform community service. (Comme un prince). Komedijos.

programme.title: Romantics Anonymous.
programme.desc: Angélique is a young French woman who suffers from social anxiety disorder and is afraid of just about everything. She regularly attends a support group for other people like her. Jean-René, who owns a small manufacturer of chocolate called the Chocolate Mill, also suffers from social anxiety, and is afraid of many things, particularly intimacy. The Chocolate Mill is failing because it makes a plain, old-fashioned kind of chocolate that no longer sells well. (Les émotifs anonymes). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: A Clever Crook.
programme.desc: Beffrois, a disillusioned police captain nearing retirement, has his curiosity aroused by a new art theft. Seemingly an art specialist, the burglar prefers works of average value. No doubt to avoid attracting attention. Another distinctive sign: he always passes by the roof. For Beffrois the investigation looks to be athletic. Direction, screenplay: Lucas Bernard (France, 2017) (Un beau voyou). [16+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: S*** in a Good Way.
programme.desc: Charlotte couldn't be happier about her relationship with her handsome boyfriend. But during a moment of intimacy, the teen's beau drops a bomb on her: He's gay. She is crushed. So, along with her best friends - the sassy spitfire Megan and the quieter Aube - Charlotte seeks distraction at a toy store. There, the three girls are charmed by the young, male employees and quickly land jobs alongside them. Charlotte, still heartbroken, starts flirting - and having casual sex - with a few of her new coworkers. Initially, she loves her new freedom. Others around her, however, feel differently, leading them to smear Charlotte's name and challenge her newfound sexual empowerment. (Charlotte a du fun). [16+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Chinese Puzzle.
programme.desc: Ten years have passed, and the once happy lovers, Xavier Rousseau (Romain Duris) and Wendy (Kelly Reilly), have split. When she moves with their two children to New York City, he also moves to there to be near the children. Wendy now lives with John (Peter Hermann (actor)) in a luxury apartment overlooking Central Park. Xavier initially stays with Isabelle (Cécile de France) and Ju (Sandrine Holt), a lesbian couple whose child he fathered, but he soon finds his own apartment above a Chinese bakery where he works on a new novel assisted by brief visions of Arthur Schopenhauer and Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel. (Casse-tête chinois). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Breakfast on Pluto.
programme.desc: Set in the 1970s, "Breakfast on Pluto" follows the exploits of Patrick Braden (Cillian Murphy), an endearing, witty, clever and deceptively tough young transvestite. Abandoned as a baby in his small Irish hometown, Patrick is aware from a very early age that he has been born into the wrong body. He survives this harsh environment with the aid of his wit and charm, plus a sweet refusal to let anyone and anything change who he is. With a burning desire to find his mother and reconciliation, he moves to London, and a hilarious, memorable and emotional series of misadventures sees Patrick, or Kitten as he prefers to be called, finally finding the love and happiness he craves. (Breakfast on Pluto). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Ramen Shop.

After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients. (Ramen Teh). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Love Me No More.
programme.desc: Antoine Méliot is around 40 years old and has everything he needs to be happy: a beautiful wife, two adorable children, friends he can count on, a pretty house in the Yvelines and money. But one day he decides to ruin everything in one weekend. (Deux jours à tuer). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Duchess.
programme.desc: 18th century England. Married at 17 to the rich and powerful Duke of Devonshire, Georgiana quickly charms high society with her stunning beauty, wit and love of life. However, behind this flamboyant image hides a woman who longs to be loved, a woman deserted by her husband - the only man in the kingdom indifferent to her charms - who prefers her best friend Elizabeth Foster, and who obliges her to accept a ménage à trois. Unhappy and unsatisfied, Georgiana leads a hectic social life. Her elegance, her extravagance and her taste for gambling create a sensation, particularly when she throws herself into politics alongside the Liberal Party. She's celebrated by princes and ministers. And she supports the young Member of Parliament, Charles Grey, with whom she falls passionately in love. (The Duchess). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Cathedral.
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become. (The Cathedral). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Certified Copy.
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany. (Copie conforme). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Flash Gordon.
programme.desc:
Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.
(Flash Gordon). Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: The Third Man.
programme.desc: Classic film noir about an American writer who visits postwar Vienna to see an old friend, but is told that his friend is dead. Incredulous at the suggestion his friend was a criminal, the writer attempts to clear the dead man's name, but soon finds events taking a strange turn - his friend is very much alive, dealing drugs on the black market. (The Third Man). [12+]. Mistika. Trileriai.

programme.title: Hidden Beauties.
programme.desc: Two young Tunisian women strive for the same emancipation enjoyed by men. (Millefeuille). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Youth.
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Harvey Keitel star in this comedy-drama about ageing from Italian director Paolo Sorrentino (The Great Beauty). Retired classical music conductor and composer Fred Ballinger (Caine) is holidaying at a plush hotel in the Swiss Alps with his best friend, the veteran film director Mick Boyle (Keitel). It's supposed to be relaxing, but Ballinger's tranquillity is disturbed by an emissary of the Queen, who wants him to perform one last time for her. Meanwhile, Boyle is fretting because funding for his latest (and, he hopes, greatest) project relies on him securing the participation of his long-time leading lady Brenda Morel (Jane Fonda). The two men also pointedly and ruefully reflect on their lost youth and opportunities; something that's not helped by the current Miss Universe's (Madalina Ghenea) penchant for shedding her clothes whenever she bathes in the hot tub with them. Also starring Rachel Weisz as Ballinger's daughter, who's married to Boyle's son (Tony Dano). (Youth). Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: The Young Lovers.
programme.desc: Elegant, retired architect Shauna (70) crosses paths with Pierre, a happily married doctor in his 40s, who first made an impression on her in a brief meeting 15 years previously. Both are quite troubled to meet again and begin an affair. While Pierre's family life is soon turned upside down, Shauna struggles with feelings she thought belonged to the past. (Les jeunes amants). [16+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Jayne Mansfield's Car.
programme.desc: The film is set in 1969 Morrison, Alabama. The Caldwell family includes three World War II veterans—brothers played by Thornton, Bacon and Patrick—their sister Donna (LaNasa), and a patriarch, Jim Caldwell (Duvall), who is a World War I veteran. The Caldwells are involved in a cultural clash with the Bedfords, a family which includes Phillip (Stevenson), a World War II veteran, his sister Camilla (O'Connor), and their father Kingsley (Hurt), also a World War I veteran. (Jayne Mansfield's Car). Dramos.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: In Our Prime.
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there. (Isanghan naraui suhakja). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Painted Veil.
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth. (The Painted Veil). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Only You.
programme.desc: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman meets the love of her life. They decide to spend the whole night together. (Only You). Romantiniai.

programme.title: Diane.
programme.desc: Diane fills her days helping others and desperately attempting to bond with her drug-addicted son. As these pieces of her existence begin to fade, she finds herself confronting memories she'd sooner forget than face. (Diane). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Practice.
programme.desc: Gustavo, an Argentine yoga instructor living in Chile who recently lost his wife and home while an injury prevents him from continuing with his yoga practice. (La práctica). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Like a Prince.
programme.desc: Souleyman, a French boxing champion in preparation for the Olympic Games, sees his future crumble when he cracks the bones of his hand following a bar fight. He is sent to the Château de Chambord, where he must perform community service. (Comme un prince). Komedijos.

programme.title: Romantics Anonymous.
programme.desc: Angélique is a young French woman who suffers from social anxiety disorder and is afraid of just about everything. She regularly attends a support group for other people like her. Jean-René, who owns a small manufacturer of chocolate called the Chocolate Mill, also suffers from social anxiety, and is afraid of many things, particularly intimacy. The Chocolate Mill is failing because it makes a plain, old-fashioned kind of chocolate that no longer sells well. (Les émotifs anonymes). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: We Love You, You Bastard.
programme.desc: A war photographer and absent father, who spends more time taking care of his camera than his four daughters, enjoys a happy life in the Alps with his new girlfriend. But his life is turned upside down the day that his best friend tries to reconcilate him with his family by telling them a big lie. (Salaud on t'aime). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ladies.
programme.desc: Lucie is in remission and her illness is almost a distant memory. Her family pushes her to live life to the fullest, and in doing so Lucie meets the charming and arrogant Clovis, who is immediately beguiled by her wit and humor. It is Dalila, however, an eccentric and delightful dance teacher, who inspires Lucie to rebuild her life and to grow into the woman she always wanted to be. For her mother, for her daughter, for Clovis. (De plus belle). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Vera Drake.
programme.desc: Vera Drake is a selfless woman who is completely dedicated to her working class family who love her. He spends his days adoring them, and also takes care of his sick neighbor and old mother. And he secretly visits women and helps them have abortions. Something like that was illegal in England in the 1950s. Vera sees it as helping women in need, and she does it with a smile on her face and words of encouragement. However, when the authorities discover her, Vera's world and family life quickly unravel. (Vera Drake). [12+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Big Nothing.
programme.desc: Jean-Baptiste Andrea's dark comedy stars Simon Pegg and David Schwimmer as Gus and Charlie, two workers at a call centre that deals with software problems, who come up with a plan to blackmail pillars of society who are downloading porn. Unfortunately, their plans soon go awry and the body count rises. As Charlie's policewoman wife Penelope (Natascha McElhone) gets too close to the truth, FBI agent Hymes (Jon Polito) closes in from another angle and Gus's ex-girlfriend Josie (Alice Eve) also finds herself involved. (Big Nothing). Trileriai. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Apaches.
programme.desc: Renji continues to meets with Chihiro every day after school, though he wonders if he should continue with such a half-hearted attitude. It rains one day after school, so Renji does not go to meet Chihiro, thinking that she would not come under the circumstances, but she comes anyway and manages to catch a cold, something Renji feels terrible about later on. Hiro goes out during school with Miya into town and they have lunch at a café. After Hiro accidentally forgets her given name, Miyako leaves him behind at the café. Kyosuke quits the film club, and even breaks up with his girlfriend. (Apaches). [18+]. Dramos. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Saint Frances.
programme.desc: Critically acclaimed, offbeat comedy-drama written by and starring Kelly O'Sullivan. Thirty-something waiter Bridget (O'Sullivan) finds herself adrift in life. She's yet to begin the career she wants, because she doesn't know what she wants to be. And she's yet to settle down and start a family, because she doesn't know if she wants to get married and be a mum. Indecision rules in Bridget's life. When she takes a summer gig as a nanny for an at times rather demanding six-year-old, Frances (Ramona Edith Williams), Bridget starts learning some important life lessons from the child as well as her two mums, Maya (Charin Alvarez) and Annie (Lily Mojekwu). Sometimes, even the most together of people don't really know what they're doing. And maybe that's OK. Directed by Alex Thompson. Network Premiere. (Saint Frances). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle.
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: My First Time.
programme.desc: Zachary is 20 years old. Dark and independent, he collects amorous conquests and school failure. Sarah is 18 years old. First class, fragile, she fills her emotional gaps with perfect control of his life. Nothing should close and yet, the year of the tank, for six months, they will live a love against which nothing can be, the true, the big one that marks a life forever. (Ma première fois). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Selma.
programme.desc: Biopic chronicling the three-month period in 1965 which saw Dr Martin Luther King Jr lead a march from Selma to Montgomery. Despite the passing of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed segregation, many black people still found they were being denied fundamental rights. In the face of extreme opposition from many who were determined to undermine their efforts, King and his fellow campaigners endured damaging smears and shocking physical attacks on the path to securing equal voting rights. (Selma). Dramos.

programme.title: Nicostratos le pélican.
programme.desc: Yannis is a 14 year old boy who lives an isolated life with his dad on a small Greek island. After the death of his mother, two of them didn't talk much. One day, Yannis finds a young pelican and decides to take it home. His friendship with the pelican, and meeting with the impulsive 15 year old girl, will mark a change in his life, that will eventually lead to reconciliation with his father. (Nicostratos le pélican). Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Best Is Yet to Come.
programme.desc: Following a monumental misunderstanding, two childhood friends (Fabrice Luchini and Patrick Bruel), each one persuaded that the other only has a few months left to live, decide to put it all aside to catch up on lost time and share their remaining days, with a little touch of joyful madness. (Le meilleur reste à venir). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.title: S*** in a Good Way.
programme.desc: Charlotte couldn't be happier about her relationship with her handsome boyfriend. But during a moment of intimacy, the teen's beau drops a bomb on her: He's gay. She is crushed. So, along with her best friends - the sassy spitfire Megan and the quieter Aube - Charlotte seeks distraction at a toy store. There, the three girls are charmed by the young, male employees and quickly land jobs alongside them. Charlotte, still heartbroken, starts flirting - and having casual sex - with a few of her new coworkers. Initially, she loves her new freedom. Others around her, however, feel differently, leading them to smear Charlotte's name and challenge her newfound sexual empowerment. (Charlotte a du fun). [16+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: A Bronx Tale.
programme.desc: Drama set in 1960s New York about an Italian American boy surrounded by conflicting influences while growing up in the Bronx. The boy's father is almost powerless to do anything when his son becomes increasingly corrupted by a neighbourhood gangster. The two father figures - one hard-working and loving, the other involved in dangerous, underworld activities - exert conflicting pressures and beliefs. (A Bronx Tale). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Summer Hours.
programme.desc: Two brothers and a sister witness the disappearance of their childhood memories when they must relinquish the family belongings to ensure their deceased mother's succession. (L'heure d'été). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: No Chains No Masters.
programme.desc: On a island controlled by French settlers in 1759, Massamba accepts his fate as a slave but his daughter Mati flees from the plantation. He has no choice but to break his chains and set off on a desperate search for her. (Ni chaînes ni maîtres). Dramos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire.
programme.desc: Danny Boyle's multi-Oscar-winning drama opens with Jamal Malik (Dev Patel), a call centre chaiwallah (tea seller), on the verge of winning 20 million rupees on the Indian version of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?. But the show's host (Anil Kapoor) thinks Jamal's cheating and hands him to the police to beat the truth out of him. Jamal tells them he knows the answers because they relate to significant episodes in his life, which are then told in flashback. It's the tale of a seemingly inseparable friendship between Jamal, his brother Salim and their friend Latika, which is ultimately soured by Salim's actions. But Jamal's appearance on the TV quiz offers a chance of reconciliation, as well as great riches. Patel is outstanding in his role, with Jamal also being played at different stages of his life by Tanay Hemant Chheda and Ayush Mahesh Khedekar. Madhur Mittal, Ashutosh Lobo Gajiwala and Azharuddin Mohammed Ismail play Salim; with Frieda Pinto, Tanvi Ganesh Lonkar and Rubina Ali as Latika. In English, and Hindi with English subtitles. This screening of Slumdog Millionaire is in commemoration of Irrfan Khan who died April 29th aged just 53. (Slumdog Millionaire). [12+]. Dramos. Kriminalai. Romantiniai.

programme.title: 2 Days In Paris.
programme.desc: Marion is a French-born photographer living in New York City with her Neurosis, hypochondriacal, chain-smoking, heavily tattooed American interior designer boyfriend Jack. After a markedly unromantic trip to Venice, which was planned to re-ignite the passion in their relationship, they take a night train to Paris to pick up Marion's cat from her parents and decide to stay for two days. Jack is startled to learn Marion has remained in contact with numerous ex-lovers and becomes increasingly uncomfortable due to the language barrier and a multitude of her old flames she keeps meeting. Meanwhile, Marion wrestles with her own insecurities about love, relationships, and her impulsive nature. (Deux jours à Paris). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth. (The Painted Veil). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Cathedral.
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become. (The Cathedral). [12+]. Dramos.

When a man and his family are found brutally murdered in a suburb outside Stockholm, Detective Inspector Joona Linna tries to persuade a doctor, Erik Maria Bark, to hypnotise a traumatised witness. But it has been ten years since Erik last practised hypnosis, and he has promised never to do it again. When he finally agrees, a chain of terrifying events starts. (Hypnotisören). Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle.
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer.
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Muzikiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Happy Single.
programme.desc: A couples therapist who doesn't believe in love has her stubborn convictions put to the test when a one-night fling turns out to be a new daily co-worker. (Happy Single). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Lost in Paris.
programme.desc: ""Two on the Aisle"" - A salute to NY's Shubert Theater with Steve Lawrence & Eydie Gorme. --Steve & Eydie perform a medley of songs from ""Golden Rainbow,"" their current play at The Shubert Theater. They also perform selections from earlier Shubert plays. (Paris pieds nus). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Selma.
programme.desc: Biopic chronicling the three-month period in 1965 which saw Dr Martin Luther King Jr lead a march from Selma to Montgomery. Despite the passing of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed segregation, many black people still found they were being denied fundamental rights. In the face of extreme opposition from many who were determined to undermine their efforts, King and his fellow campaigners endured damaging smears and shocking physical attacks on the path to securing equal voting rights. (Selma). Dramos.

programme.title: My First Time.

programme.title: The Third Man.
programme.desc: Classic film noir about an American writer who visits postwar Vienna to see an old friend, but is told that his friend is dead. Incredulous at the suggestion his friend was a criminal, the writer attempts to clear the dead man's name, but soon finds events taking a strange turn - his friend is very much alive, dealing drugs on the black market. (The Third Man). [12+]. Trileriai. Mistika.

programme.title: Flash Gordon.
programme.desc:
Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.
(Flash Gordon). Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Nightcap.
programme.desc: In Lausanne, the aspirant pianist Jeanne Pollet has lunch with her mother Louise Pollet, her boyfriend Axel and his mother. Lenna leans that when she was born, a nurse had mistakenly told to the prominent pianist André Polonski that she would be his daughter. André has just remarried his first wife, the heiress of a Swiss chocolate factory Marie-Claire "Mika" Muller and they live in Lausanne with André's son Guillaume Polonski. Out of the blue, Jeanne visits André and he offers to give piano classes to help her in her examination. Jeanne becomes closer to André and sooner she discovers that Mika might be drugging her stepson with Rohypnol. Further, she might have killed his second wife Lisbeth. (Merci pour le chocolat). [16+]. Kriminalai. Mistika. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire.
programme.desc: In late 18th-century Brittany, painter Marianne is commissioned by an affluent countess to paint a portrait of her sheltered daughter Héloïse so that she can be appraised by a prospective suitor in Milan. A previous attempt couldn't be completed as Héloïse refused to pose for the artist, so Marianne has to finish the portrait in secret by pretending to be a companion for Héloïse, who is unhappy at the prospect of marriage to a stranger. In French with English subtitles. (Portrait de la jeune fille en feu). Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: No Chains No Masters.
programme.desc: On a island controlled by French settlers in 1759, Massamba accepts his fate as a slave but his daughter Mati flees from the plantation. He has no choice but to break his chains and set off on a desperate search for her. (Ni chaînes ni maîtres). Dramos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: The Surrogate.
programme.desc: Regina agrees to go on a date with Steve's old pal Clyde, but only if Steve joins them and escorts a friend of hers. Meanwhile, Lydia doesn't realize that the cheerleaders only want to hang out with her because she works in a hip clothing shop. - _ - When Lovita gets a tattoo, Cedric strongly objects. Refusing to be drawn into the middle of a marital spat, Steve ushers them out of his apartment so he can prepare for a date. But when former band mate Clyde arrives looking for some help in finding his way home, he inadvertently ruins the cover story Steve used to get Paula to come to dinner. Meanwhile, after Lydia is assigned to work on a class project with Romeo and Bullethead, the school's cheerleaders target her for friendship in order to take advantage of her employee discount at a popular clothing store. As Cedric and Lovita continue to disagree over the tattoo, Clyde falls head over heels in love with Regina. And when Steve presses her for just one date with his old friend, Regin (The Surrogate). Dramos.

programme.title: Iris.
programme.desc: When the young Iris Murdoch meets fellow student John Bayley at Somerville College, Oxford, he is a naive virgin easily flummoxed by her libertine spirit, arch personality, and obvious artistic talent. Decades later, little has changed and the couple keeps house, with John doting on his more famous wife. When Iris begins experiencing forgetfulness and dementia, however, the devoted John struggles with hopelessness and frustration, and becomes her caretaker, as his wife's mind deteriorates from the ravages of Alzheimer's disease. (Iris). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Summer Hours.
programme.desc: Two brothers and a sister witness the disappearance of their childhood memories when they must relinquish the family belongings to ensure their deceased mother's succession. (L'heure d'été). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Little Witch.
programme.desc: The little witch is only 127-years-old, so just a youngster to the big witches. Despite being forbidden, she celebrates the Dance of the Witches on the Brocken Mountain on Walpurgis Night. As punishment, she has one year to learn the big book of spells by heart, and then her fate will be decided. Determined to be the best witch she can, she gets down to work, supported by her talking raven, Abraxas. At first reluctantly and then increasingly, she discovers helping people instead of annoying them with pranks makes her feel good. But the big witches, especially the scary weather witch Rumpumpel, are suspicious. For them, the last thing about being a really good witch is good deeds. And this puts the little witch in a terrible dilemma when it comes to her final test. (Die kleine Hexe). Komedijos. Fantastiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Ladies.
programme.desc: Lucie is in remission and her illness is almost a distant memory. Her family pushes her to live life to the fullest, and in doing so Lucie meets the charming and arrogant Clovis, who is immediately beguiled by her wit and humor. It is Dalila, however, an eccentric and delightful dance teacher, who inspires Lucie to rebuild her life and to grow into the woman she always wanted to be. For her mother, for her daughter, for Clovis. (De plus belle). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: We Love You, You Bastard.
programme.desc: A war photographer and absent father, who spends more time taking care of his camera than his four daughters, enjoys a happy life in the Alps with his new girlfriend. But his life is turned upside down the day that his best friend tries to reconcilate him with his family by telling them a big lie. (Salaud on t'aime). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Romantics Anonymous.
programme.desc: Angélique is a young French woman who suffers from social anxiety disorder and is afraid of just about everything. She regularly attends a support group for other people like her. Jean-René, who owns a small manufacturer of chocolate called the Chocolate Mill, also suffers from social anxiety, and is afraid of many things, particularly intimacy. The Chocolate Mill is failing because it makes a plain, old-fashioned kind of chocolate that no longer sells well. (Les émotifs anonymes). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Like a Prince.
programme.desc: Souleyman, a French boxing champion in preparation for the Olympic Games, sees his future crumble when he cracks the bones of his hand following a bar fight. He is sent to the Château de Chambord, where he must perform community service. (Comme un prince). Komedijos.

programme.title: Gainsbourg: A Heroic Life.
programme.desc: The film follows notorious musician Serge Gainsbourg's exploits from his upbringing in German military administration in occupied France during World War II through his rise to fame and love affairs with Juliette Gréco, Brigitte Bardot and Jane Birkin to his later experimentation with reggae in Jamaica. It also incorporates multiple elements of fantasy, most significantly with the character called "The Mug", an animated exaggeration of Gainsbourg that acts as his conscience (or anti-conscience) at crucial moments in Gainsbourg's life. The film also includes many of Gainsbourg's more famous songs, which serve as the soundtrack to the film and often serve as plot elements themselves. (Gainsbourg (vie héroïque)). Muzikiniai. Dramos.

programme.desc: The film looks over the life of a young man, Younes, from his childhood in Algeria in the 1930s to nowadays. The story goes over the tragedies that occurred in his country like the battle of Mers El-Kebir and the Algerian War but also the love story of Emilie and Younes. (Ce que le jour doit à la nuit). Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost.
programme.desc: Nick Brady and his girlfriend Maria, Pablo Escobar's niece, are making hurried plans to leave Colombia with Nick's brother, Dylan, when Escobar summons Nick to a meeting. He tells the gathered men, many of whom are his family, that he intends to surrender himself to the authorities and that they will have to take action in his absence to protect his fortune. Most of the men agree immediately. Nick is visibly hesitant but agrees when Pablo asks him directly for his help. (Escobar: Paradise Lost). Dramos. Romantiniai. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Certified Copy.
programme.desc: Drama. French drama, produced in 2010. While in Tuscany to promote his latest book, a middle-aged British writer meets a French gallery owner woman who is also a fan of his books and they set off on a tour of Tuscany. (Copie conforme). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Cathedral.
programme.desc: An unconventional autobiography, THE CATHEDRAL presents the complex tapestry of conflict-filled family relationships that will shape the life and future filmmaking career of Jesse, a kid growing up in New York from the 1980s to the mid-2000s. The film shows us the life of Jesse and his family at different stages like the chapters of a novel. Ricky D'Ambrose is one of those filmmakers whose style can be described as unique, apart from very specific vignettes, he uses photos, newsreels and TV commercials to convey the world as Jesse experiences it. At the same time, the film is fundamentally a biography of his problematic father, but also of his mother, stepfathers, uncles, aunts, grandparents and great-grandparents - the twisted "cathedral" that built the young man that Jesse would become. (The Cathedral). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: White Dog.
programme.desc: As the country explodes under racial tensions after the assassination of Martin Luther King, writer Romain Gary, humanist and animal lover, and his wife, star Jean Seberg, civil rights activist, welcome an abandoned dog into their home, trained to jump at the mouths of blacks: a White Dog. (Chien blanc). Dramos.

programme.title: Jethica.
programme.desc: Director Pete Oh's largely improvised supernatural comedy stars Ashley Denise Robinson and Callie Hernandez as two women dealing with a particularly persistent stalker in a particularly novel way. Elena (Hernandez) has been hiding out in her grandmother's trailer because she killed someone. But who? Cue flashback to Elena lighting a witchy-looking candle in a trailer in a desert before giving a rather vacant looking chap with grey skin a lift in her car. At a gas station, she randomly bumps into Jessica (Robinson), a high-school friend. Turns out Jessica is being stalked by a guy called Kevin (Will Madden) who has a lisp, hence the title's 'Jethica'. And sure enough, Kevin turns up in the desert too. Except it can't be Kevin 'cos Kevin's in the boot of Jessica's car. So what in Sam's dusty, yellow hell is going on here? And how in the name of tumbleweed can Elena and Jessica get rid of Kevin? Network Premiere. (Jethica). Komedijos. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Stranger on the Run.
programme.desc: Rochebrune nears chaos after protest leader Johnny vanishes post-heist. His childhood friend Paul retraces old memories to find him before the police do. (Un homme en fuite). Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Year Of the Fox.
programme.desc: YEAR OF THE FOX follows Ivy, a teenager navigating Aspen's party scene amidst her adoptive parents' bitter divorce. As she watches her community provide cover for predatory behavior, Ivy struggles to find her path without losing herself. (Year Of the Fox). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Plėšrūno mąstysena.
programme.desc: Visose buveinėse viešpatauja plėšrūnai. Ne jėga, o intelektu ir strategija. Nuo kobros, apskaičiuojančios kitą kirtį, iki liūtės, strateguojančios užpuolimją - medžioklė prasideda plėšrūno galvoje. (Mind of a Predator). Gamtos. Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Plėšrūno mąstysena.
programme.desc: Nuo ežių iki vėžlių ir nuo koralų iki ryklių - rifuose gyvena daugybė būtybių, turinčių ypatingų gebėjimų prisitaikyti, kad galėtų klestėti savo nišoje. (Mind of a Predator). Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Galingosios upės.
programme.desc: Laukinė laivams neskirta legendinė Afrikos Zambezė išsiskiria didžiausiu pasaulyje kriokliu, įspūdingais slenksčiais ir žmogėdromis krokodilais. Džeremis tiria, kodėl šiai didžiai upei gresia bėda. (Jeremy Wade's Mighty Rivers). Gamtos. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Gyvenimas žemiau nulio.
programme.desc: Aliaskos gyventojai turi išnaudoti trumpas dienos šviesos valandas gyvybiškai svarbiems įrankiams gaminti, savo žemei prižiūrėti, maistui rasti ir išgyvenimo įgūdžiams lavinti. (Life Below Zero). [12+]. Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Koralų miestas.
programme.desc: Belgijos mokslinių gamtos tyrimų komanda drauge su jauna mokslininke Kushlani Dissanayake leidžiasi į ekspediciją aplink Šri Lanką. Tyrimo metu siekiama surinkti svarbią informaciją apie koralinius rifus, jų DNR ir juos veikiančią aplinką. Visi tyrimų rezultatai bus panaudoti vienam tikslui - koralinių rifų apsaugojimui nuo išnykimo. Per Kushlani profesines pastangas ir asmeninę motinystės istoriją susipažįstame su giliaisiais Šri Lankos vandenimis, taip pat mokslininkės požiūriu į motinystę, žmoniją ir teoriją apie "geriausiųjų išlikimą". (Coral City). Laukinė gamta. Gamtos.

programme.title: Jeloustounas: Amerikos tiksinti bomba.
programme.desc: Jeloustounas yra vienas galingiausių superugnikalnių Žemėje; kokios būtų pasekmės, jei jis išsiveržtų? Žymiausi ekspertai atskleidžia skirtingus galimus galingo Jeloustouno išsiveržimo scenarijus. (Supervolcan Yellowstone : Menace sur la planète ?). Gamtos.

programme.desc: Didžiosios Britanijos dvarai - tikri šios šalies nuostabių kraštovaizdžių perlai. Penelopė Kit stebi, kaip jų savininkai daro viską, kas įmanoma, kad užtikrintų pajamas ir neleistų sugriūti stogui. (Saving Britain's Country Houses with Penelope Keith). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Gelbstint Didžiosios Britanijos dvarus su Penelope Kit.
programme.desc: Viltšyro Ifordo dvare vyksta oranžerijos naujinimo darbai. Čevenidžo rūmuose atskleidžiamas išskirtinis palėpės geležinkelio maketas. Pradedamas restauruoti istorinis "Pitchford Hall" namelis medyje. (Saving Britain's Country Houses with Penelope Keith). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Atskleistos dingusių žvėrių paslaptys.
programme.desc: Triragis triceratopsas yra vienas garsiausių dinozaurų, dažnai vaizduojamas kovojantis su liūdnai pagarsėjusiu plėšrūnu - tiranozauru. Ar šie du priešistoriniai titanai tikrai kovojo vienas su kitu? (Lost Beasts Unearthed). Mokslas. Gyvūnai. Gamtos.

programme.title: Atskleistos dingusių žvėrių paslaptys.
programme.desc: Gauruotasis raganosis kadaise klajojo po šiaurinę Europą. Dabar nauji atradimai oloje pietryčių Anglijoje atskleidžia, kas iš tikrųjų pražudė šį ledynmečio monstrą. (Lost Beasts Unearthed). Gamtos. Mokslas. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Arkties veterinarai.
